author: in2forex
text:
Hi All

I have been watching the current EURUSD chart, trying to get a more live feel for the market. I had marked where I expected price to turn in the FTR *White line". It just didn't go that low. I nice 3Drive and diamond as I see it.

author: in2forex
text:
Hi All

From now on a bit of a mixture in my journal. I will still continue with some homework going back in history and dropping in time frame to see why price turned. I'm also keen to start some trading exercises with Forex Tester and live charts.

But first back to doing some homework.

author: in2forex
text:
Ok Trade from Friday

1) Entry QM formed at H4 Supply, entered at QM Level. 2) Exit early, I didn't have time to watch PA through the morning, I thought price might go back up to close the gap. I didn't want to give anything back, so I exited. Price would have hit my second TG.

author: Oedipus
text: This is such a well constructed explanation of a bad trade I've learned a ton from it, thanks. I wouldn't beat yourself up too much. We are all getting better, we're not just not getting it.

author: Oedipus
text: I don't know if you've ever learned a language but you learn word after word after word and don't feel like your getting anywhere. Then all of a sudden it falls into place and you can understand people. This is very much the same thing. I'm still waiting for it to happen myself

author: polymorph
text:
Hey In2forex,

Great spot on the QM, sorry it didn't work out. Have you read anything about hooks? Capn P and Wolverine talk a bit about them in their journals and they seem quite effective. I pointed out the hook in blue that could have given you another shot at this one.

author: in2forex
text:
polymorph wrote: Hey In2forex,

Great spot on the QM, sorry it didn't work out. Have you read anything about hooks? Capn P and Wolverine talk a bit about them in their journals and they seem quite effective. I pointed out the hook in blue that could have given you another shot at this one.

Hi Polymorph

Thanks for taking the time to make up the chart. I must admit I've hear the term but not paid much attention to them. One of my current challenges with Forex Tester is that it's too easy just to fast forward, In this case I was very irritated that I was stopped out. I wasn't looking for a second bite at the pie. Something I should take note of!

author: in2forex
text:
Oedipus wrote: I don't know if you've ever learned a language but you learn word after word after word and don't feel like your getting anywhere. Then all of a sudden it falls into place and you can understand people. This is very much the same thing. I'm still waiting for it to happen myself

Hi Oedipus

Thanks for your comments. Your analogy of the language made me think of something I heard many years ago. The best way to learn a language is to fall in love with somebody who speaks the language you want to learn.

Well I do "love" Forex trading but it feels like a bit of a bad marriage at the moment.
